response:
It is completely understandable to feel frustrated when you make a mistake, and you are not "weird" for reacting this way. Many people struggle with intense self-criticism and feel overwhelmed by anger at themselves. However, hitting yourself or pulling your hair is a form of self-harm. This indicates that your emotional pain is very high right now, and you deserve support to find safer, gentler ways to cope with those feelings. 

Because you are hurting yourself, please consider reaching out for immediate support. You can text HOME to 741741 to reach the Crisis Text Line, or call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. Speaking with a mental health professional can also be incredibly helpful in learning how to be kinder to yourself when things go wrong. You don't have to carry this heavy burden of frustration all on your own.
